title: rowshape.com performance, security, UI/UX backlog
surface: docs-site/ (Astro 7 + Starlight 0.42, deployed to Cloudflare Pages at https://rowshape.com)
how_this_works: Follows seo-prd.json (SEO is done there and not repeated here). One iteration fixes one story end to end: change, `npm run verify` (build + scripts/check-build.mjs), commit. Where a story can be guarded, the guard goes into check-build.mjs so it cannot regress. Every story records what was VERIFIED, not what was intended. Local builds need Node >=22.23.4 (Astro 7.4 engines).

audit_baseline.method: three parallel read-only audits of the built dist/ (49 pages): security + delivery pipeline (npm audit, dist inline-script census, workflow review); performance + accessibility (Playwright + axe-core 4.10.2 on all 49 pages at 375px in both themes, focus walk, forced-colors, reduced-motion); UI/UX + content (screenshots of homepage desktop/mobile light/dark, a finding page, install, 404, catalog)
already_good: axe: zero violations on homepage, findings, reference, 404 in both themes at 1280px
no horizontal page scroll at 375px on any of the 49 pages
skip link is the first tab stop; one <main> plus header/nav/footer landmarks; visible focus on every tab stop
only common.css is render-blocking (11 KB gzip); no web fonts; no third-party origins
workflow actions SHA-pinned, least-privilege permissions, deploy gated off fork PRs
no target=_blank links, so no missing rel=noopener
gaps_found: npm audit --omit=dev: 13 vulnerabilities (1 critical: Astro 7.1 AVIF RCE; 10 high incl. sharp/libvips, Astro JSX XSS). Pending dependabot branches would not have fixed them
no public/_headers: no HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, framing protection, COOP, and /_astro/* hashed assets not long-cached
no Content-Security-Policy; Starlight's inline scripts are byte-identical across pages so a hash-based CSP is feasible
no /.well-known/security.txt; deploy job rebuilds instead of shipping the checked artifact, wrangler unpinned, no protected environment
check-build's 32 KiB JS budget counts only <script src>; real per-page JS is ~100 KB because the search UI (94 KB) loads on idle on every page
axe scrollable-region-focusable on 7 tables at 375px; unnamed code-block regions (landmark-unique); empty <th> on /privacy/; copy-button icon vanishes under forced-colors
default Starlight look: stock accent, default star favicon, no favicon.ico (browsers get the 14 KB 404)
homepage has no example SQL or verdict output; no quickstart page; install page doesn't say npm/Homebrew are pre-release and links the Action guide to /agent/
29 'PRD §' and several INV-* references on public pages that readers cannot open
finding pages are a dense Remediation paragraph with no example of failing/fixed SQL; sidebar lists 28 long finding titles; GitHub Action buried under CLI reference
no FAQ / comparison with squawk, strong_migrations; exit codes and CI usage only in README

stories.title: Upgrade the vulnerable build stack and gate CI on npm audit
verified: astro 7.1.0 -> 7.4.2, @astrojs/starlight 0.41.3 -> 0.42.7, sharp 0.34.5 -> 0.35.5, @astrojs/markdown-remark -> 7.3.4, @astrojs/sitemap -> 3.7.4; `npm audit --omit=dev` went from 13 vulnerabilities (1 critical, 10 high) to 0
Astro 7.4.2 requires Node >=22.23.4; recorded as package.json engines. CI's `node-version: 22` resolves to the latest 22.x, which satisfies it
docs-deploy.yml build job now runs `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high` after npm ci
`npm run verify` passes on the new stack: 49 pages, every existing check-build assertion green

stories.title: public/_headers: baseline security headers and immutable caching for hashed assets
stories.plan: HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, X-Frame-Options DENY, COOP on /*; /_astro/* immutable 1y; /pagefind/* short max-age. check-build asserts each header and that every dist/_astro file name carries a hash.

stories.title: Hash-based Content-Security-Policy generated from dist after build
stories.plan: scripts/gen-csp.mjs hashes every executable inline script in dist/**/*.html and writes the CSP into dist/_headers (header, not <meta>, so frame-ancestors works). Pagefind needs wasm-unsafe-eval + worker-src self. Verify zero CSP violations in Playwright across all pages and an opened search before enforcing; check-build fails if any inline script hash is missing.

stories.title: security.txt and deploy-job hardening
stories.plan: public/.well-known/security.txt from SECURITY.md (Contact, Expires <1y, Policy, Canonical) with a check-build expiry guard. Workflow: persist-credentials false, pin wranglerVersion, deploy ships the checked build artifact instead of rebuilding, don't cancel in-progress deploys on main.

stories.title: Load the search UI on intent, and make the JS budget count what pages really load
stories.plan: Override Starlight Search so the 94 KB ui-core chunk loads on focus/hover/click/Ctrl+K instead of on idle. check-build follows dynamic import() from loaded chunks and reports initial vs deferred JS.

stories.title: Keyboard-scrollable tables, named code regions, no empty table headers
stories.plan: rehype plugin wraps tables in a focusable labelled region; code blocks wrap on narrow screens so they stop becoming unnamed scroll regions; fix the empty <th> on /privacy/. check-build fails on bare tables and empty <th>.

stories.title: Brand theme, real favicon set, forced-colors fixes, lighter social card
stories.plan: customCss with brand accent (#2E4A7D family) in light and dark with AA contrast; logo + favicon.svg/.ico/apple-touch-icon; forced-colors rule for the copy button; og.png palette-encoded under 40 KB.

stories.title: Homepage shows the product: migration in, verdict out, above the fold
stories.plan: Under the hero: failing migration SQL beside the `rowshape validate` output; how-it-works Steps (pull, hydrate, validate); Tabs for CLI / GitHub Action / MCP. Move 'The problem' below.

stories.title: Quickstart: install to first verdict
stories.plan: New /quickstart/ built from demo/ and the README quickstart; every command checked against the CLI. Sidebar after Install, second hero action, 'Next' link from install.

stories.title: Install page: pre-release truth, platform tabs, correct links
stories.plan: Caution aside for channels that land with the first tag; Tabs per platform; fix the 'GitHub Action guide' link that points to /agent/ and the off-site docs/action.md link; supply-chain detail collapsible.

stories.title: Remove internal planning references (PRD §, INV-*) from public pages
stories.plan: Rewrite or drop them at the source (content, generator inputs, registry summaries); check-build fails on 'PRD §' or INV- in dist.

stories.title: Finding pages get a fixed structure with a failing and a fixed example
stories.plan: Extend the findings registry with example/fixed SQL; generator emits What it means / Example / How to fix / Related. Spec references become links. Staleness tests and `rowshape explain` stay consistent.

stories.title: Sidebar and navigation for the CI and integration reader
stories.plan: Integrations group (GitHub Action, MCP); findings grouped by namespace, collapsed, labelled by code; useful prev/next on findings; 404 points at search and explains the RS-XXX-000 shape.

stories.title: FAQ with comparison, and a 'rowshape in CI' page
stories.plan: FAQ answering how rowshape differs from static linters (squawk, strong_migrations) and pgroll; CI page with exit codes and warn-as-fail. Included in llms.txt and the sitemap.

stories.title: Rollup: re-run all three audits against the merged site and close or re-open every story
